collection.description: Nothing remarkable happens in the village today.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Nothing remarkable happens. A baker burns one loaf, a child loses a sandal, two friends argue over a song, and an elder naps through lunch.

b.text: Someone tells a ridiculous story and everybody remembers it.

c.text: A historian notes that ordinary days are most of a community's life.

a__fx.text: The village ends the day fed, tired, and mostly content.
